economy.summary: In a 2026 voter guide survey, she said she is advancing legislation to alleviate the property tax burden on seniors and veterans and has active legislation to reduce permitting wait times for major capital investments and job creation.
economy.short: Proposes property tax relief for seniors, faster permitting for jobs.

taxes.summary: She is the prime sponsor of the Taxpayer Protection Act, a proposed state constitutional amendment that would limit the growth of state government spending, which she describes as putting guiderails around how taxpayer dollars are spent.
taxes.short: Sponsors constitutional amendment limiting state government spending growth.

abortion.summary: Voted yes in July 2022 on Senate Bill 106, a package of proposed state constitutional amendments including one declaring that the Pennsylvania Constitution does not grant any right relating to abortion or to taxpayer-funded abortion.
abortion.short: Voted for amendment declaring no state constitutional abortion right.

education.summary: In a 2026 voter guide survey, she said that on school funding, simply spending more money will not fix the problem and that the state must demand accountability and measurable results; she supports statewide purchasing power for textbooks, structured literacy initiatives, and expanded partnerships with local industry.
education.short: Says demand accountability over more spending; supports literacy, industry partnerships.

healthcare.summary: Sponsored Senate Bill 25, which would allow certified nurse practitioners to provide primary care in rural counties independent of a physician after a three-year collaboration period, saying rural residents often travel far to access care and the change would expand health care access.
healthcare.short: Sponsors bill expanding nurse practitioner care in rural counties.

energy.summary: Supported the Senate's 2025 passage of a bill repealing Pennsylvania's participation in the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, which she calls an electricity tax that would raise rates, cut energy and manufacturing jobs, and close power plants; she also co-chairs the Senate Gas and Oil Caucus.
energy.short: Supports repealing RGGI, calling it an electricity tax; backs gas industry.

guns.summary: Co-sponsored Senate Bill 565 in 2021, which would have allowed carrying a concealed firearm without a license in Pennsylvania; the bill passed the Senate 29-21 in November 2021 and was vetoed by the governor.
guns.short: Co-sponsored bill allowing concealed carry without a license.
